decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with through contacts build directly on the firm's glass processing, drilling and bonding know-how, and its in-house R&D and EU research projects give it the related knowledge to interpret early results and refine the product.

Carrier wafers for smaller-diameter wafers extend the firm's established carrier and thin-wafer handling offer and fit its strategic direction, so its existing knowledge lets it learn from early customer feedback and improve the product.
